root_cause.bug: ane_pmgr_has_state used of_get_child_by_name(np, "power-controller@268"). of_node_name_eq (drivers/of/base.c:59-71) strips the '@unit' part before comparing: len = strchrnul(node_name,'@') - node_name = 16 ('power-controller'), and requires strlen(name) == len; strlen("power-controller@268") = 20. The name can never match. All PMGR state children share the name 'power-controller' and differ only by unit address.
root_cause.live_tree_proof: /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/soc/power-management@28e080000 compatible=apple,t6000-pmgr with direct children power-controller@268 label=ane_sys and power-controller@2c8 label=ane_sys_cpu; kernel boot log also showed 'apple-pmgr-pwrstate 28e080000.power-management:power-controller@2c8: sync_state() pending due to 284000000.ane'.
root_cause.fix_commit: 16720f0 'Find PMGR power states by label, not unit address': scan pmgr children by label property, derive register offset from the unit address, match parents by shared 'apple,pmgr' compatible (drops the per-SoC config table).

handoff_bug_list.bug: EBUSY resource overlap: ANE engine reg span 0x284000000+0x2000000 covered the DART window 0x285800000+0x4000 already claimed by apple-dart (285800000.iommu).
handoff_bug_list.evidence: dmesg: "error -EBUSY: can't request region for resource [mem 0x284000000-0x285ffffff]"; /proc/iomem consumer 285800000.iommu.
handoff_bug_list.fix: DT overlay engine size 0x1800000 (ends exactly at DART base); omarchy-linux 8d13ef5e9c031cd4a8f79facaedf5dc66d993912.

handoff_bug_list.bug: NULL pointer oops at ane_platform_probe+0x558 (ane_drv.c:828): T6001 exposes ONE power-domain entry which the core attaches implicitly; ane_attach_genpd returned pd_count=1 with pd_dev NULL, later dereferenced.
handoff_bug_list.evidence: Verbatim oops 'Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference'; module stuck Loading refcount 1.
handoff_bug_list.fix: Normalize implicit single-domain case to zero manually attached domains; omarchy-ane 499bae3618758aebca100c126a4063f21c9123b4.

handoff_bug_list.bug: PMGR lookup always failed: ane_pmgr_has_state used of_get_child_by_name(np, "power-controller@268"), but of_node_name_eq strips the '@unit' part (len 16) while strlen("power-controller@268")=20 - name can never match; every pmgr state child is named 'power-controller'.
handoff_bug_list.evidence: Clean -ENODEV 'power: no supported PMGR ANE power states' with unbound device, while live tree proved power-management@28e080000 (apple,t6000-pmgr) held labeled children ane_sys@268 and ane_sys_cpu@2c8.
handoff_bug_list.fix: Label-based child scan + offset derived from unit address + 'apple,pmgr' compatible (drops per-SoC table); omarchy-ane 16720f0.

handoff_bug_list.bug: CLOSED isolation: insmod of the PMGR-fixed module hard-resets because ane_iommu_remap_ttbr writes dart1/dart2 TTBR. SError 0xbe000000 on CPU during insmod immediately after 'probe: domains on, remap ttbr'.

narrowed_cause.summary: The cycle-4 hard reset is ane_iommu_remap_ttbr dart1/dart2 TTBR writes. Force-power of ane_sys@268 and ane_sys_cpu@2c8 plus dart0 TTBR read are stable.
